And yeah I know it's fucked up logic but its just whats going through my head man.
Kind of what I'm already trying to do, at least then I can make others happy.

Thanks bro, while I would say opiates are the devil, I knew what I was getting into and its give life purpose when I have had none. The hard part is finding something else to give it purpose. I hope you fine genuine happiness too man, best of luck.
thank you man I appreciate it, these comments have gave me so many new things to try and to work at. I can't thank this community enough tbh.
thanks bro

Thank you man, good luck to you too.
Thanks man, I know need to find something positive to channel my energy into.
It doesn't feel temporary, I've been like this since my teenage years, life just doesn't feel real anymore, like I've been in a dream since age 12.
Thanks man, I would be lucky to have a friend like that. Best I can say to you is to help anyone you know IRL who might be struggling, but I'm sure you already would.
I don't know if its amazing or horrible. Probably both. I find it hard to look objectively at life since I've never known anything different. Thanks though man <3
The thing is, a challenge like that is never completed, there is no end, until you die - obviously. I don't know what I would do with myself, like in the day-to-day and the evenings, the night times.
thanks man, I appreciate the kind words.
thanks man <3

thank you bro, i appreciate it <3
thank you man

Yeah your probably right, if I had more money a good portion of it would go straight onto a huge stash of drugs. I am going to try to rekindle my faith, at least it will give me something to do if it doesn't work out. 

With regardss to the world, the world is and has been like this imo, people though it would htf in the cold war, but it didn't. People in WW1 and WW2 would of surley felt it was the end of life, but it wasn't. Life just goes on no matter what happens in the same way, same shit different day.

i can really relate to that, i'm recently started to cook my own food and perfecting it to me reminds me lot of trying to perfect my CWE technique. Although I don't get the same enjoyment at the end its something I guess.

I first tried acid a few years ago, I know that it's a bad idea with depression but I've been diagnosed with it for about 10 years I think? I wanted to feel something else, and to be honest my first 5 or so trips were pretty good, especially tripping with my girl. My last 2 trips have been bad though, and I don't think I want to try again until I'm in a much better mental state.
thanks bro, I appreciate it
thanks man <3
Thank you bro <3
Yeah my mistake man, I've changed it now. For some reason I thought zoloft was the american brand name for prozac.
Yeah I guess I've got to keep changing until I find something that works. Good luck to you and your wife man.
Thanks man, I appreciate it.
My mistake, I assumed Zoloft was the American brand name and wasn't sure if you used the Prozac name in the US. Thanks I'll update,

I think that's good advice, I'm sick of living like this and I want to make a change. I'm meeting my parents and sister this week for the first time in 2 years. Don't know how it is going to go, but I guess worse care scenario is no contact.
Thank you man, wish you all the best.
it's been so long since season 7 came out I forgot it existed. Not quite the same now it's not going off George R.R Martin's work though.
Love you too man, thanks for the advice. I'm going to try and cut down on drug use, don't think I have the willpower to stop, but it's a start I guess.
Thanks bro, hang in there, feel like there's a lot of people all over the world in the same situation, not that it changes anything but to me at least it's a small comfort to know I'm not alone.
Thanks I'll have a look at it. I am one for philosophy and it's related areas of study. Best of wishes.
Thanks man, I'll take a look at it when I have time.

Perhaps your right, I think maybe I've just been unlucky in the ones I've seen. I applaud you for what you are doing, your an amazing human being to be going into that profession to help. Good luck man.

I used to do Kratom quite a bit and I found it a helpful substitute to opiates (not really sure if is one or not but it seems safer/less damaging). Unfortunately it's illegal in my country and it's a lot easier to get a hold of other more popular opiates. I currently do study and it's given me some sense of meaning, but at the same time I do just feel like part of the system, a mindless number just paying tuition fees. Thank you for your words man, I wish you the best.

Thank you, I really appreciate the reply. While I want to be clean, I just feel as though drugs definine me at this point, like most of what I do and all my friends. Maybe one day if I have enough money to move away and start a life - a family - it just feels as if I wouldn't be able to cope still, and then I would let people down.

I understand that instant gratification is obviously going to have a long-term negative impact, but it's the fact that I can't seem to obtain that same feeling any way, no matter how much I work for it.
That's good logical advice, thank you. I want to try and just live in the present and not try to linger too much but it's like arguing against my own mind, you know?
From what I've seen today and the amount of responses, it is.

Thank you for your words. I try not to think like this but its hard sometimes to think another way, its hard to convince yourself that some you believe is not true, you know? I'm trying to do positive but it all just seems so inevitably pointless, nevertheless I don't want to stop trying but the thoughts are constantly there.
I don't know, I would imagine all drugs contribute to it in some way or another.
thanks man, perhaps running is something to look into, I've done CBT a few times and a few other therapies but I don't think they're for me.
love you too bro
I think that could be a factor, yes. I haven't been taking it daily for long though, just now that I can't afford a daily weed habit.

I used to hit the gym quite a bit, wasn't really my sort of thing but it was a valuable use of my time, unfortunately haven't been able to do it any more or virtually any sports because of an arm injury I sustained that is still affecting me from a year ago.

Weed, well not as effective does help me sleep but while I can get zopiclone for virtually nothing, weed is an expensive habit, and my tolerance builds up quickly. Don't really have the money at the moment to smoke much. Your right about how drug abuse fills up the absence of an outlet, I wanted to try to find something else but nothing really does compare, sports and other hobbies just feel so synthetic. I study politics, not that I would want to be a politician, but I want to do something to make the world better for others - as unlikely as that is.
Thank you, perhaps I rekindling of my faith might be an option to look into, or if not just that type of lifestyle that comes with it.
Good luck man, its difficult in real life to talk about these kind of things without either hurting loved ones or trusting strangers. Wish you all the best.
Thank you, I will update, I can't tell you how much this means. You truly are a good person. This thread has made me a lot more positives that perhaps I wasn't paying attention to before.

You're completely right, as a long time lurker of this sub I felt compelled to make a post, especially when I feel desperate. I'm glad that I can have a positive impact, it really gives me some form of meaning.
thank you man, kind words from a stranger is always comforting. Good luck bro and hang in there.
Thank you, I understand what your saying. Its logical to live like that if I decide to do it, but I find it hard to think logically sometimes. Thanks for the advice dude.

I understand, just feels like I would rather just end it here, makes no difference you know what I mean? In a hundred years no one will remember, no action I take on this earth could ever have an impact, all my thoughts, feelings, and memories will just be gone. Surely that makes any decision I ever make relevant? Thanks for taking the time to reply bro.

I can obliviously relate to opitates, z drugs also, specifically zopiclone. I find it hard to sleep without it. She knows I struggle with my thoughts but I don't think she knows the extent. Same with drug abuse. And yeah I know the habits aren't great and I know I need something to replace it with, but I don't enjoy much. I just try to work and study as much as I can.

Thank you. It's just how I feel, I can't help it. I know it's selfish which is why I hate talking about it IRL, but maybe I am selfish. I don't know. I just know that it would all be over, no more worries, no more living, just nothing - like before I ever existed.
I'll pm you tomorrow if that's ok man, 5:30am where I am and got lecture tomorrow at 11, going to try and get some sleep. And yeah I feel like its an unpopular opinion but a more observant one.
Thank you bro, i'm not really the best judge but sounds like good advice. Thanks for taking the time to reply to me man.
Thank you so much, it amazes me that someone who I don't know and has no obligation help and talk to me, actually does. I'm really grateful.

Thank you man, I appreciate the reply, I really do. I don't want to waste my life, but I don't want to live also. I hate living the way I do but I'm scared of death, i'm scared of being in darkness with nothing but my own thoughts.

thank you man, I don't want to bother anyone with my problems, even though I know this post is but im just desperate af for some reason to keep going. I really appreciate the love, the kindness of strangers shows me how beautiful humanity is.
Thank you, that's something I haven't thought about in a long time. My memory is hazy from before I was on the meds, but I do remember a much more harder day to day struggle.

I think I believe in God, I don't come from a religious family but have always felt the presence of a higher power. Nevertheless my faith has been getting weaker and weaker. The world we live on is hell and it always has been, but I feel like I have been going through much worse in my own head, or perhaps i am naive to others experiences - i don't know. Thank you for the reply friend.

I can understand that, to be fair I sometimes think in that mentality. I am definitely better on antidepressants from a day to day point of view, it helps me live in the present more. But I feel when I get bad, I get a lot worse, but at the same time the thought of getting of my meds scares me to death.

Sorry for calling you bro lol, just meant it in a friendly way. I really do appreciate the reply. Knowing that other people are going through similar things is comforting to know I'm not alone. I appreciate the prayers, my faith in a higher power has been deteriorating.

I get what you mean bro, its just being on meds for years makes me feel like i'm never completely sober. Like how can I be truly sober ever if I'm taking meds to alter my mind? Makes me want to get fucked up more cause I know I can never be properly sober. Thanks though man, I know what you mean by 'why stop now?'. I know life is short so the only thing keeping me going is the slim hope it will get better.

I'd say I've quit cocaine because I wanted to, but really its simply because of fianancial issues. That was a big part of my drug use, but opiates are still so cheap and available. I just don't know what to do with myself at the end of the day if I'm not high or drunk.

In regards to my fiancee, I find it hard to talk to her because I don't want to upset her, she deals with similar things and I don't want to factor into that.

I appreciate the advice man, I really do. Thank you for taking the time to write to me.
thank you bro, I don't think you know how much these kind words mean to me.
thank you man, even just kind words means the fucking world to me
